=============
Documentation
=============

The csvconfig package provides functionality for reading csv files 
and returning their contents as tables, including rules checking 
for csv configuration files. 

The content of the package is owned by Prover Technology AB. 

Revision history
----------------

Version 1.1.2
-------------

-------------
